# Bundled OMIE raw examples

The files in this directory are small public OMIE/OMEL market-data examples
used for tests and documentation. Their raw data content is kept unchanged;
local filenames for consolidated result files may be standardized by
`omie2fdata` for reproducibility.

Source: OMI-Polo Español, S.A. (OMIE), public electricity-market information.

Main source pages:

- Consolidated/day-ahead market results: https://www.omie.es/es/market-results/daily/daily-market/day-ahead-price
- Public file repository: https://www.omie.es/es/file-access-list
- OMIE legal notice: https://www.omie.es/es/aviso-legal

OMIE states that public and free information on its website may be used freely
provided its original content is respected, and that OMIE must be cited as the
source when information is used in its original format.

A suggested data citation is:

> OMI-Polo Español, S.A. (OMIE). OMIE electricity-market public data,
> [market-results or file-access dataset], https://www.omie.es/, accessed
> [date].

These files are data supplied by OMIE; the GPL-2 license of the R package code
does not replace OMIE's terms for the source data.
